FN-3PPT4ZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 335
Committee: Economic Development and Tourism Sponsor: Representative Andy Whitt
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/25/2025
House Bill 335 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Construction Trade
Academy Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of additional residential
building permit fees of up to $20 levied by local governments, as provided by this bill. This bill
would also provide further for the award and administration of grants from the fund by the
Alabama Home Builders Licensure Board.
According to 2024 preliminary data from the Census Bureau, there were 17,690 building
permits for new privately owned housing units in Alabama.
